where: app.html · unit stat block, base line
why: The code is general: it takes every entry of s.baseWith in order and renders it as '<base> w/ <wargear>' after s.base, joined with ' · '. A unit with no baseWith gives [s.base].join(' · ') === s.base, the same string as before. A missing base gives '' both before and after, because join turns undefined into ''. The whole joined string goes through esc(), so the wargear names (object keys) and the base values are escaped as well. The only baseWith in data.js is the Skitarii Rangers' (line 6919). Snapshots against a render of 8cc6829 show one changed stat line, '25mm' → '25mm · 60×35.5mm Oval w/ Transuranic arquebus'. Screenshots at 390px and 320px wrap cleanly inside the name column with no overflow and the stat columns stay aligned; at 320px '60×35.5mm' and 'Oval' land on separate lines, which is cosmetic only. The screens and small-phone render steps pass with 0 failures.
